LANDING.TITLE: Run your contact operations in a focused and private control panel
LANDING.SUBTITLE: Create an account or sign in to manage contacts, tags, and CSV workflows with account-level isolation.
LANDING.CARD_SCOPE_TEXT: Each user sees and manages only their own contacts and tags. Backend ownership checks are enforced on every API request.
LANDING.CARD_FILTER_TEXT: Use search, tag filters, company filters, favorite flags, and sorting to find the exact record in seconds.
LANDING.CARD_IMPORT_TEXT: Import and export CSV files with row-level error feedback so you can correct invalid entries quickly.
LANDING.CARD_SECURITY_TEXT: Firebase authentication is verified by the API and unauthorized sessions are redirected to login safely.
LANDING.WORKFLOW_STEP_1_TITLE: Sign in and enter your workspace
LANDING.WORKFLOW_STEP_1_TEXT: Authenticate with email/password or Google and open your account-specific contact area.
LANDING.WORKFLOW_STEP_2_TEXT: Create new records, edit details, assign tags, and keep favorites ready for frequent use.
LANDING.WORKFLOW_STEP_3_TEXT: Export filtered lists or import bulk data through CSV while keeping your data ownership boundaries intact.
LANDING.FEATURE_PRIVATE_CONTACTS: Each account sees only its own contacts and tags.
LANDING.FEATURE_FILTERS: Fast search, sort, favorites, and tag-based filtering.
LANDING.FEATURE_IMPORT_EXPORT: Bulk import and export through CSV workflows.
